title: AI Grid: Collection health
description: The measurement pipeline itself: addon agents' remote write per cluster, 30 s cadence on both paths, the hub's Thanos receive and compactor, local Prometheus heads, exporters up, Submariner tunnels, API-server reviews.

Sites with every grid peer collected

Remote-write delivery lag (oldest unsent, worst agent)
panels.description: Age of the newest sample each queue has successfully sent; the worst agent per site. highest_timestamp_in_seconds would advance on receipt even when sending stalls.

panels.title: Compactor halted

Cadence (samples in two minutes; 30 s sampling gives 4, the agents' default 300 s gives at most 1)

panels.description: highest_timestamp_in_seconds is one gauge per agent (no queue label); the sent timestamp is per queue, so the oldest queue is taken.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="open-cluster-management-agent-addon"}) - on (cluster, pod) min by (cluster, pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="open-cluster-management-agent-addon"})
